title: Bulk Calling Cards Library Preparation
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwhfpb6
materials: At this point, gel electrophoresis can be performed to check the quality of amplification. We recommend running 5 uL of the PCR product from step 23 on 1% TAE agarose gel. The expected product is a smear extending from ~1 kb up to 5 kb. As a control, we recommend that the constitutive β-actin gene be amplified in parallel to the calling card libraries in steps 22 and 23. The control amplification uses the same PCR mix and thermocycler settings as step 22 and 23, but replaces the calling card forward and reverse primers with human β-actin primers (sequence provided in Materials as Raff_ACTB_F and Raff_ACTB_R). The expected product of the B-actin amplification is 626 bp (see Figure 1 in https://doi.org/10.2144/97233st02 ). Representative products of SRT amplifcation 1% TAE gel showing expected products of SRT amplification. Left: the first 12 lanes are biological replicates of a calling card experiment, while the thirteenth is a no template control. The calling card libraries appear as smears extending up to 5 kb. Right: amplification of β-actin with Raff_ACTB_F and Raff_ACTB_R from the same RT product as the SRT samples produces the expected 626-bp product. The ladder is NEB's 1 kb Plus (previously, 2-Log) DNA Ladder (#N3200S).

steps.title: Harvest cells and pellet
steps.instruction: Dissociate adherent cells with trypsin or a cell scraper if needed, then collect each replicate separately. Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min, aspirate all supernatant. Do not overload gDNA Eliminator columns: if >1 × 10⁷ cells, split the lysate onto two columns and later merge the RNA pools.

steps.title: Lyse cells and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add Buffer RLT Plus (supplemented with 2‑mercaptoethanol) to the cell pellet using the volume table provided. Vortex or pipette to mix, then homogenize the lysate by vortexing briefly and letting it rest on the bench for 1 min. Optionally homogenize with a QIAshredder spin column or by passing repeatedly through a 20‑gauge needle.

steps.title: Remove genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a gDNA Eliminator spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube. Centrifuge for 30 s at ≥8 000 g. Ensure no liquid remains on the membrane; repeat centrifugation if necessary. Discard the column and keep the flow‑through.

steps.title: Add ethanol to flow‑through
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume (either 350 µL or 600 µL, matching the lysate volume) of 70 % ethanol to the flow‑through and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Bind RNA to RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample to an RNeasy spin column in a 2 mL collection tube. Spin for 15 s at ≥8 000 g and discard the flow‑through. If the sample volume exceeds 700 µL, repeat the loading step with successive batches, discarding flow‑through each time.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1 to the column, spin for 15 s at ≥8 000 g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RPE (first)
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the column, spin for 15 s at ≥8 000 g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RPE (second)
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash, but spin for 2 min at ≥8 000 g. Discard the flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: DNase I digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare DNase solution by mixing 10 µL DNase I with 70 µL Buffer RDD per sample. Add 80 µL of this solution to each column and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Post‑DNase wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL Buffer RW1 to the column, spin for 15 s at ≥8 000 g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new collection tube and centrifuge for 1 min at ≥8 000 g to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a fresh 1.5 mL tube, add 40 µL RNase‑free water, and spin for 1 min at ≥8 000 g to elute RNA. Store RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL of RNA in 9 µL of ddH₂O, then quantify using the Qubit RNA HS Assay Kit.

steps.title: Prepare reverse transcription mix
steps.instruction: For each replicate, combine 2 µg total RNA, 1 µL 50 µM SMART_dT18VN primer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, and ddH₂O to a total volume of 14 µL. Incubate at 65 °C for 5 min, then place on ice for 1 min.

steps.title: Add RT enzymes and buffer
steps.instruction: To the cooled RT mix add 4 µL 5X Maxima RT Buffer, 1 µL RNaseOUT, and 1 µL of 0.5X Maxima RT H Minus enzyme (prepared as a 1:1 mixture of 1X Maxima RT Buffer and Maxima RT H Minus enzyme). Mix by pipetting and incubate at 50 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 85 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: RNase H cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase H to the reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min to remove the RNA strand from the cDNA‑RNA duplex.

steps.title: PCR amplify cDNA (self‑reporting transcripts)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR mix: 25 µL 2X Kapa HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, 1 µL 25 µM Reverse Primer (SMART), 2 µL cDNA, 21 µL ddH₂O, and 1 µL Forward Primer (either 25 µM SRT_PAC_F1 for PB‑SRT‑Puro or 25 µM SRT_tdTomato_F1 for PB‑SRT‑tdTomato). For half‑size reactions, halve each component. Run the thermocycler: 95 °C 3 min; 20 cycles of 98 °C 20 s, 65 °C 30 s, 72 °C 5 min; then 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup of PCR product
steps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads at room temperature (≥30 min). Add 30 µL beads to each 50 µL PCR (0.6× ratio; use 15 µL for half‑size reactions). Mix by pipetting 10 times, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on a magnetic rack for 2 min, and discard the supernatant. Wash the beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol (≥30 s each), discarding supernatant each time. Air‑dry the pellet for 2 min, then elute DNA with 20 µL ddH₂O, mix, and incubate off‑rack for 2 min. Place on magnetic rack for 1 min (or until clear) and transfer the eluate to a new tube. Dilute 1:10 and quantify with the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit; expected concentration 10–20 ng/µL.

steps.title: Tagment PCR product
steps.instruction: Take 1 ng of the purified PCR product and bring to a total volume of 5 µL ddH₂O in a PCR strip. Add 10 µL Nextera Tagment DNA (TD) Buffer and 5 µL Amplicon Tagment Mix (ATM), mix, briefly spin, and incubate at 55 °C for 5 min. Then add 5 µL Neutralization Tagment (NT) Buffer, mix, briefly spin, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Nextera PCR with barcodes
steps.instruction: Add to each tagmented tube: 15 µL Nextera PCR Mix (NPM), 8 µL ddH₂O, 1 µL 10 µM barcoded piggyBac primer (e.g., OM‑PB‑ACG), and 1 µL 10 µM indexed Nextera N7 primer (e.g., Nextera_N701). Run the thermocycler: 95 °C 3 min; 13 cycles of 95 °C 10 s, 50 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; then 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup of final library
steps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads (≥30 min at RT). Add 35 µL beads to each 50 µL Nextera PCR (0.7× ratio), mix 10 times, incubate 5 min at RT, place on magnetic rack for 2 min, and discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 70 % ethanol (≥30 s each) and discard. Air‑dry the pellet 2 min, then elute with 11 µL ddH₂O, mix, and incubate 2 min off‑rack. Place on magnetic rack for 1 min (or until clear) and transfer eluate to a new tube. Dilute 1:10 and measure concentration using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit or TapeStation (High Sensitivity D1000). Expected concentration 2–4 ng/µL; fragment size distribution 300–600 bp.

steps.title: Sequencing recommendations
steps.instruction: Sequence libraries on any Illumina platform. Add PhiX to a final concentration of 50 % due to low library complexity. Use single‑end reads (≥75 bp) for read 1; include an Index 1 read for demultiplexing.

steps.title: Prepare Maxima RT buffer and enzyme dilution
steps.instruction: For ≤5 samples, combine 1 µL 5X Maxima RT buffer with 4 µL ddH₂O to make 1× buffer; store on ice. Make a 0.5× enzyme dilution by mixing equal volumes of Maxima RT H Minus enzyme with the 1× buffer (e.g., 2 µL enzyme + 2 µL buffer). Use 1 µL of this 0.5× dilution per sample; avoid pipetting volumes <1 µL.
